verdict.rationale: Skyvern's own docs say agents built with Copilot can be scheduled. That is a first-party claim, but it is a single thin mention. Nothing in the pack documents recurring cadence (cron, intervals), schedule management, or a scheduling API, so recurring scheduling specifically is only implied. Missing for 10: documented recurring schedule configuration (cron or interval), schedule management via UI or API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: It builds an agent you can test, edit in Studio, schedule and share.
